name: Odin
role: All-Father and god of wisdom, war, and death
fun_fact: Odin's two ravens fly over the world each day and return to tell him what they have seen.

name: Thor
role: god of thunder and protector of gods and humans
fun_fact: Thor can kill and eat his two goats, then bring them back to life with his hammer the next morning.

name: Loki
role: trickster and shape-shifter, blood-brother of Odin
fun_fact: Loki once turned into a mare and gave birth to Sleipnir, Odin's eight-legged horse.

name: Freyja
role: Vanir goddess of love, fertility, and battle
fun_fact: Freyja travels in a chariot drawn by two cats, and cats were sacred to her.

name: Baldr
role: god of light, beauty, and joy, whose death foreshadows Ragnarök
fun_fact: Baldr's ship Hringhorni was so large that the gods could not launch it without the giantess Hyrrokkin.

name: Frigg
role: goddess of marriage, motherhood, and foresight, and Baldr's mother
fun_fact: Frigg knows the fate of every person, but she never speaks of what she knows.

name: Ymir
role: the first giant, whose body became the world
fun_fact: In Norse thought the earth is literally a giant's body, since the mountains are Ymir's bones and the sea is his blood.

name: Mimir
role: guardian of the well of wisdom and Odin's counsellor
fun_fact: After Mimir was beheaded in the war between the gods, Odin preserved his head and consulted it for advice.

name: Sigyn
fun_fact: Sigyn catches the serpent's venom in a bowl, and the earth shakes whenever she turns to empty it.

name: Jörmungandr
role: the world serpent, child of Loki and the giantess Angrboða
fun_fact: Jörmungandr is so long that it circles all of Midgard and can bite its own tail.
